notes.title: Update to 1.1.2
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32524959/f30d8019be99b6e77171bd348e4136eb4af0d2fb.jpg

Update 1.1 is now live. It will add additional content and changes in gameplay. It will also fix numerous bugs from version 1.0. However, the old saved games from the previous version (1.0) will NOT be compatible with the new patch. 

List of Major Updates 1.1

1. Flexible Challenges

You will now be able to challenge whomever you like except the first and last opponent. However, each character attributes will increase gradually every time you defeated a character, or AS we called it “Level Up.” This will create a little bit of planning in which category that you should overcome first and which should you save for last. 

2. Town Map

You can now travel to any house you want via The Town Map. We will also provide information on the map regarding the household that resides in each home, their category and whether they have already been beaten or not. This will make navigation around the game much easier

3. Battle Reports

We also will provide an additional battle report to track player’s progress on each character in the form of a pyramid. Players will be able to track the grade of each character on one screen.

4. New Building “Library” and New character “The Librarian.”

A new building and an additional character will be added to the map. Players can battle the bonus character “The Librarian” after beating the game. The Librarian will contain every question from the database of every character. She is going to be hard, but two new Steam Achievements await those who successfully defeated her.

We’re also fixing some minor bugs such as 

- Music, SFX and, Voice volume that is too loud
- Fixed numerous typos and some obscure questions
- Added around 60 new questions

We hope this update will make this game better as a whole


Cheers

Yin Fei

notes.title: New Major Update 1.1 is coming next week
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for all the feedbacks regarding What Are You Stupid. We will implement major patch 1.1 next week that will add additional contents and changes in gameplay. However, The old savegames from the previous version (1.0) will NOT be compatible with the new patch. 

List of Major Updates

1. Flexible Challenges

You will now be able to challenge whomever you like except the first and the last opponent. However, each character attributes will increase gradually every time you defeated a character, or we called it “Level Up.” This will create a little bit of planning in which category that you should overcome first and which should you save it for last. 

2. Town Map

You can now travel to any house you want via The Town Map. We will also provide information on the map regarding the household that resides in each home, their category and whether they have already beaten or not. This will make players much easier to navigate around the game.

3. Battle Reports

We also provide an additional battle report to track player’s progress on each character in the form of a pyramid. Players will be able to track the grade of each character all in one screen.

4. New Building “Library” and New character “The Librarian.”

A new building and an additional character will be added to the map. Players will be able to battle bonus character “The Librarian” after beating the game. The librarian will contain all question database from all15 characters. She is going to be hard, but two new achievements await those who successfully defeated her.

We’re also fixed some minor bugs such as typos, sound bugs and other minor things.

Finally, we are very grateful for each feedback (Positives & Negatives), critics and supports given by all of you guys, the Youtubers, the Twitch streamers and Video Games Bloggers as well. 


Thank you and Cheers,

Yin Fei
